paragraph: Six river dolphins were born this calving season in the Mekong River in Cambodia. The people living along that stretch of water consider these animals sacred. River dolphins rank among the most endangered species in both the New World and the Old. For now, the numbers are looking up. That is something quiet to hold onto today.

seed.summary: River dolphins are among the world’s most endangered species, whether found in the New World, or the Old. Yet at least for now, things are looking up for these animals considered sacred by the people living along a stretch of the Mekong River in Cambodia, as the most recent calving season produced 6 baby dolphins.
seed.sourceTitle: Numbers of Endangered and Sacred River Dolphin Grow by 6 After Successful Breeding Season
